author: NIN Creative Studio
title: NIN Creative Studio Hiring Illustrator Artists
content: 🎨 NIN Creative Studio is Hiring! Are you passionate about Illustration and ready to turn creative ideas into compelling artwork? NIN Creative Studio is looking for Illustrator Artists – All Levels to join us on a variety of creative projects, from Characters and Creatures to Environments, Fantasy, and Game Art. 📄 Check out the full Job Description here: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4475930253/ ✨ Why join NIN? Work across diverse projects and visual styles. Flexible Freelance / Part-time / Full-time opportunities. 📩 Ready to create with us? Send your CV + Portfolio via LinkedIn or email us at nincreativestudio@gmail.com Subject: Application – Illustrator Artist – [Your Name]

author: Baltic Analog Lab
title: Looking for Illustrator for Merch Artwork
content: We’re looking for a freelance graphic designer (preferably based in Latvia) for occasional collaborations, as well as an illustrator (national or international) to create fun artwork for our new merch! Send us a DM with your Instagram account or website. And if you know someone whose work you love, share your recommendations with us!
